item.title: Tojinbo Cliffs
item.description:
Speaking of the place where the criminals are cornered by detectives in Japanese suspense dramas is Tojinbo. It is sightseeing spot cliffs on the sea. I went there.

We can watch the cliffs from above, but I was afraid, so I didn’t get too close. If I carelessly fall down, I will possibly die.

Then, I decided to take a boat tour, and I watched the cliffs from below. The guide explained the spots. Besides, I was able to look over amazing cliffs. It was pretty good.
